existing_runtime.attachment_validation: _image_inventory rejects unavailable, duplicate, symlinked, non-PNG or out-of-attempt inputs and records their SHA-256 hashes.
existing_runtime.command: _command adds a repeated --image argument for every supplied PNG, keeps --ephemeral, workspace-write sandbox, on-request approval with managed auto_review, and disables nested multi-agent pools.
existing_runtime.archive: command.json records actual image_inputs and invocation arguments. The worker checks image bytes again after execution and returns a nonaccepting outcome if they changed.
existing_runtime.completion: assess_archived_attempt independently replays result/events agreement, successful completion, thread ID, usage and nonempty final output. It does not validate scientific artifacts.
existing_runtime.existing_image_tests: tests/test_curation_codex_worker.py covers attachment order and hashes, invalid files, mutation, native errors, timeout and cancellation.
existing_runtime.modifications_required: None for image attachment or native transport. The new caller must actually supply image_paths to every author and reviewer.

recommended_orchestration.location: Sherlock Qiu group, sustained work under Slurm, selected immutable new runtime; no local native model jobs.
stages: one normal author correction if requested
recommended_orchestration.granularity: Explanatory diagram transformations, actual branches and important material/readout/interface features. Do not invoke the old five-session detailed-execution pipeline merely to transcribe each schematic.
caller_responsibilities: Freeze manifest and implementation hashes and exclusively claim a new run/attempt directory.
Copy or render each diagram as an actual regular PNG inside the author attempt, then supply it through image_paths.
Independently stage the same source image/rendition inside the reviewer attempt and supply it through image_paths there too.
Bind original image, any display rendition, source URL and rendering/crop coordinates in provenance. Attach a white-background rendition for transparent images; preserve the original.
Supply method/variant scope, source catalogue, verified bibliographic metadata and available paper evidence with its actual full-text/abstract/metadata level.
Supply exact output schema and artifact path; validate parsed JSON, graph IDs and source references after native transport succeeds.
Require source-backed review of every declared target and completeness against the diagram; positive-sounding prose is insufficient.
Keep literal figure transcription distinct from a scientifically justified correction and retain their source bindings.
On correction, pass the actual candidate and review; rerun fresh review before acceptance. Preserve previous files.
Persist per-card state, current stage, immutable inputs, output paths and terminal failure category. Resume only missing/failed work in new attempt directories, never rewrite original archives.
Do not automatically equate bibliography matching with full-paper protocol verification or cross-method novelty with documented ancestry.
recommended_orchestration.latency: The user requested full coverage, not a hard per-card time budget. Make any timeout an explicit plan option rather than silently accepting a truncated stage. The worker default is 1800 seconds unless overridden; the earlier source-only clean runner explicitly used None.
recommended_orchestration.monitoring: Track transport completion, JSON/schema failure, source failure and scientific review outcome separately. File existence alone does not establish completed extraction or acceptance.

prompt_module.context_contract: Caller-supplied JSON dictionary. Include pinned source scope, images/locators, bibliography/evidence levels, output details and reviewer candidate/targets as needed.
prompt_module.schema_contract: Nonempty JSON schema dictionary, schema text or read-only schema Path.
prompt_module.boundary: Only builds prompt text; does not acquire sources, attach images, call models, validate scientific output or admit graph edges.

temp_storage_audit.trigger: Parent observed ENOSPC under the user's normal Codex home tmp/arg0-linux directory on Sherlock.
temp_storage_audit.finding: This version constructs CODEX_HOME/tmp/arg0-${OS} and calls tempfile.tempdir_in there. No dedicated TMPDIR or CODEX_TMPDIR override was found in this code.
temp_storage_audit.implication: Changing TMPDIR does not relocate this failing arg0 path. Changing CODEX_HOME also changes auth/config/session locations and is not a temp-only solution.
temp_storage_audit.documented_related_variable: CODEX_SQLITE_HOME relocates SQLite-backed state only, not arg0 helpers.
temp_storage_audit.recommended_immediate_action: Diagnose quota and reclaim only identified rebuildable cache under existing authorization, preserving auth, managed policy and original session artifacts. The parent owns remediation; this audit changes no auth/config/cache state.
temp_storage_audit.unsupported_workaround_boundary: Relocating a temp subdirectory through a symlink is not a documented CLI setting and was not performed or validated here. Active locks, user-only permissions and sandbox behavior would require explicit checks.

independent_acceptance_audit.status: All 16 independent deterministic regression controls passed on the reviewed source snapshot. This does not establish live model behavior or scientific accuracy.
findings: Scientific State/Operation/Flow evidence must not be established solely by publication metadata.
Unresolved grouped-method applicability and unresolved source corrections must not become supported merely because the candidate omits a blocking Unknown.
Matched publications require publication sources, not an image source ID.
Positive paper-content and correction review judgments require target-appropriate source evidence.
A use_primary correction requires an explicitly authored target supported by the primary source, with the source drawing observation retained separately.
Resume policy must pin inventory as well as acquisition state and must revalidate supported artifact bytes before skipping completed rows.
Source image identity must remain bound to acquired bytes before and after rendering/stages; attached-image hashes alone do not prove original-source identity.
Native prompt archives and worker result metadata must agree with the caller's requested prompt and replayed transport evidence.
Stage failures must update stage status and distinguish transport, structural and scientific review outcomes.
independent_acceptance_audit.test_boundary: The batch controls use a fake worker that writes the existing audited transport archive shape. No actual Codex or model is invoked, and successful fixture acceptance is not scientific validation.
independent_acceptance_audit.coverage_boundary: Cached inventory completeness differs from live-site completeness and from resolution of every underlying method or non-PubMed reference.

limits: This audit does not establish successful live attachment delivery under Sherlock CLI 0.163.0; parent must inspect the actual launch archive.
Image attachment and byte integrity establish transport, not image understanding or scientific entailment.
Role instructions constrain intended behavior but require empirical scientific checks; they do not guarantee hallucination-free extraction.
